edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the recipient of _safeMint inside mintKong, letting the caller choose the mint beneficiary.
msg.sender receives the reserved tokens minted in reserveKongs.
msg.sender is the beneficiary of the balance transfer in withdraw.
block.timestamp is compared with REVEAL_TIMESTAMP to decide when startingIndexBlock is locked, making the reveal timing miner-influenced.
setProvenanceHash writes the RKL_PROVENANCE state variable.
kongPrice is read in _verifyMintKong to check msg.value covers the purchase.
maxKongPurchase enforces the per-transaction mint cap in _verifyMintKong.
MAX_KONGS bounds the total supply in _verifyMintKong.
MAX_KONGS is part of the reveal-lock condition in _setStartingIndexBlock.
MAX_KONGS is used as the modulo divisor when computing startingIndex.
REVEAL_TIMESTAMP is read in the reveal-lock condition of _setStartingIndexBlock.
setRevealTimestamp overwrites REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
saleIsActive gates the minting verification in _verifyMintKong.
flipSaleState writes the saleIsActive flag.
startingIndexBlock is read to derive the blockhash used for startingIndex.
_setStartingIndexBlock writes the locked startingIndexBlock.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock forces startingIndexBlock to the current block.
setStartingIndex assigns the computed startingIndex.
_verifySetStartingIndex requires startingIndex to still be zero.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock requires startingIndex to still be zero.
alreadyReserved is read and set in reserveKongs to prevent repeat reservations.
_owner must equal _msgSender for the onlyOwner modifier on withdraw.
_owner is checked by onlyOwner on setRevealTimestamp.
_owner is checked by onlyOwner on setProvenanceHash.
_owner is checked by onlyOwner on setBaseURI.
_owner is checked by onlyOwner on flipSaleState.
_owner is checked by onlyOwner on emergencySetStartingIndexBlock.
_owner is checked by onlyOwner on reserveKongs.
_owner must equal _msgSender for the onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership.
mintKong calls _verifyMintKong before starting the mint loop.
mintKong calls _safeMint for every requested token.
mintKong calls _setStartingIndexBlock after minting.
mintKong calls totalSupply to compute the next mint index.
setStartingIndex calls _verifySetStartingIndex before deriving the index.
_setStartingIndexBlock calls totalSupply to test the reveal condition.
reserveKongs calls _safeMint to mint the reserved tokens.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received after minting.
withdraw performs the Ether transfer operation to msg.sender.
_checkOnERC721Received makes the external onERC721Received call.
The untrusted onERC721Received callback executes during _safeMint and can reenter mintKong.
_verifyMintKong adds the requested token count to the current supply.
totalSupply result feeds the SafeMath addition used for the supply cap check.
MAX_KONGS is the modulo modulus applied to the blockhash in setStartingIndex.
setStartingIndex computes startingIndex with a modulo operation over a blockhash.

normalization_plan.reason: numberOfTokens is a parameter of mintKong that directly controls the mint loop count.
revealTimeStamp is the parameter assigned to REVEAL_TIMESTAMP by setRevealTimestamp.
provenanceHash is the parameter stored by setProvenanceHash.
baseURI is the parameter forwarded to _setBaseURI by setBaseURI.
saleStart is the constructor parameter used to derive REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
mintIndex is the local token id computed and passed to _safeMint inside mintKong.
hashOfBlock is the local blockhash value used by setStartingIndex to derive the index.
balance is the local cached contract balance transferred by withdraw.
loopIndex_i is the local loop counter of the mint loop in mintKong.
